ratios.quote: The Current Credit Agreement requires that the Company maintain a maximum Consolidated Total Leverage Ratio of less than 4.25 to 1.00. At December 31, 2025, the Company was in compliance with such covenant and the ratio was 3.63 to 1.00.
The Company must also comply with a minimum Consolidated Interest Expense Ratio of 3.00 to 1.00. At December 31, 2025, the Company was in compliance with such covenant and the ratio was 6.33 to 1.00.

parsed.notes: Current Credit Agreement is the Fifth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement (GPIL). On Feb 26, 2026, Amendment No. 1 raised the maximum Consolidated Total Leverage Ratio to 5.00x for periods ending Mar 31, 2026 through Dec 31, 2026 and to 4.75x for Mar 31, 2027 through Jun 30, 2027 (future limits, not reported as entries). Leverage-based pricing grids are excluded.
